ceo.title: Chief Executive Officer
ceo.alt: Hamza S. Ralsan Sangare, Founder & CEO of AfriNuts Export
bio: Hamza S. Ralsan Sangare is the Founder and CEO of AfriNuts Export, leading the company’s vision to build a vertically integrated, ethical cashew value chain rooted in Côte d’Ivoire. With three generations of family farming heritage in Odienné and a professional background in software engineering and project leadership, he combines tradition with modern execution.

Hamza applies a systems-driven approach to agribusiness, leveraging cloud technologies, digital platforms, and traceability tools to support scalable farm-to-export operations. He holds certifications in AWS Cloud, ITIL® 4, and CompTIA Project+, and applies Agile and service management principles across operations and strategic planning.

Under his leadership, AfriNuts is developing a 50-hectare regenerative cashew farm with a long-term vision for local processing, certified exports, and community-centered growth. Hamza is committed to building a business where Islamic values, transparency, and global quality standards converge—ensuring African agricultural value remains on the continent while serving international markets with integrity.
ceo.experience: 5+ years of leadership across agribusiness development, project execution, and technology-enabled operations.

cfo.title: Chief Financial & Operating Officer
cfo.role: Ethical Financial Architect & Value Chain Strategist
cfo.alt: Sekou Hakim, CFO of AfriNuts Export
bio: Sekou Hakim architects financial systems where profitability converges with prophetic principles, implementing Sharia-compliant frameworks that transform traditional agribusiness economics. His stewardship replaces extractive models with regenerative finance - where 20% of profits actively rebuild communities through wells, mosques, and farmer education.

As both financial guardian and operational strategist, Sekou oversees the complete monetization of our cashew value chain, from soil to shelf. He engineered the transition from raw commodity exports to in-country processing, designing capital structures that fund Odienné's first modern processing facility while maintaining rigorous profit-sharing (Mudarabah) standards.

Under his leadership, AfriNuts achieves the rare balance of fiscal discipline and social impact: deploying blockchain-enabled transparency for investors, fair trade premiums for farmers, and Islamic microfinancing for equipment - proving ethical finance can drive competitive advantage in global markets.

bio: Muhamadue Kouyaté leads global commercial operations with a focus on ethical, interest-free business practices and strategic market expansion. Drawing on over a decade of experience in compliance, logistics, and operations, he builds sustainable trade partnerships and scalable processes rooted in transparency and integrity.
cco.experience: 12+ years in operations management, supply chain logistics, and regulatory compliance.
education: Associate of Applied Science in Aviation Operations
